AIRPORT ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 21, 2024
  4700 AIRPORT PLAZA DRIVE
  LONG BEACH MARRIOTT, 4:00 PM

Geetanjali Reuben, Chair  Mireya LaFarga, Commissioner
Mark Christoffels, Vice Chair  Katie Larson, Commissioner
Phyllis Arias, Commissioner  Randy Zarn, Commissioner
Kenneth Brown, Commissioner

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-55632  Recommendation to approve the minutes from the Airport Advisory Commission
  meeting on October 17, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-55633  Recommendation to receive and file presentation regarding the LGB Business
  Partner Spotlight.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-55634  Recommendation to receive and file report from the Sustainability Committee,
  regarding Airport sustainability efforts with air quality, energy conservation, water
  quality and waste management.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-55638  Recommendation to establish an ad-hoc Committee for the limited purpose of
  identifying one to two Airport Advisory Commission members for the Wings of
  Fame Program Committee, to clarify exhibit goals and inductee nomination criteria.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-55635  Recommendation to receive and file Monthly Airport Staff Reports for November
  2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Airport Advisory Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS
